The enum is replaced by the string literal 'forbid' in the new model_config (see the Config-class migration), so the import is dropped and ConfigDict is added for the new config."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/customers.py:9:config-class"], "search": "    class Config:
        allow_population_by_field_name = True
        anystr_strip_whitespace = True
        extra = Extra.forbid", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(
        populate_by_name=True,
        str_strip_whitespace=True,
        extra="forbid",
    )", "explanation": "Per the 'Changes to config' guide, the inner `class Config` is deprecated and replaced by a `model_config` dict built with ConfigDict. `allow_population_by_field_name` is renamed to `populate_by_name`, `anystr_strip_whitespace` is renamed to `str_strip_whitespace`, and `Extra.forbid` becomes the string 'forbid'."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/customers.py:19:config-class"], "search": "    class Config:
        allow_mutation = False", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)", "explanation": "Per the 'Changes to config' guide, `allow_mutation` was removed and `frozen` is its equivalent with inverted meaning. `allow_mutation = False` therefore becomes `frozen=True`, and the inner `class Config` is replaced by `model_config = ConfigDict(...)`."}], "notes": "Three edits, all in app/customers.py. The import edit removes `Extra` and adds `ConfigDict`, since `Extra` is no longer used once `extra` is a string literal. The Customer and AuditEntry edits replace the deprecated inner `class Config` blocks with `model_config = ConfigDict(...)`. Edits do not overlap and each search string occurs exactly once. Behavior note: `frozen=True` on AuditEntry matches v1 `allow_mutation=False` for assignment, but in v2 frozen models also become hashable (they get a generated `__hash__`), which v1 did not do. I left this as is because it is the documented equivalent and the finding asks for it, but it is worth a check if AuditEntry instances are ever used in sets or as dict keys. The Customer `Field(..., alias=...)` definitions are unchanged and remain valid in v2. No other changes were needed."}
